name: skillradar
description: Discover, safety-scan, classify, rank, inspect, and route Codex tasks to high-signal agent skills, with project-aware matching and a read-only skill-context budget doctor.

interface.shortDescription: Find the right skill and keep Codex context lean
interface.longDescription: Route Codex tasks against a bundled safety-gated core + design + general registry using task-first Matching v2.1 with bounded project context, and diagnose skill catalog pressure with the read-only Skill Budget Doctor.
defaultPrompt: Query SkillRadar's bundled registry first, route this task with task evidence plus bounded project-context evidence, and use manage-skills when the Codex skill catalog is crowded
